recent_settled_decisions: Use Operator-as-manager with bounded specialists rather than a loose autonomous swarm.
Repository-native checkpoints and queues are durable memory; chat transcripts are not.
Private connector data stays in its native system of record.
External side effects keep explicit approval gates regardless of model/runtime.
Agent status must be maintained in the durable queue whenever active Mission Rated work materially changes.
Stale operational state is a defect and must be reconciled before material work.
Every successful production verification writes an immutable SHA-specific report to the release-audit branch for future agent review.
The founder Command Center and durable agent JSON must not be publicly served without an authenticated server-side gate.
READY is deployment state only; release health requires release-audit evidence and relevant production behavior checks.
Growth scorecard data must identify an authoritative durable source and freshness; measurement claims must follow verified persistence evidence.
Browser-origin checks are not authentication for privileged Supabase operational or Growth write surfaces.
Production Growth event persistence uses Vercel OIDC with explicit Supabase-side verification rather than copied service-role credentials.
Automated production visual QA must suppress Mission Rated analytics so release verification does not contaminate Growth measurement.
Family Pass and Business Share Kit acquisition measurement must remain within the supported event contract; unsupported custom events must not be represented as measured Growth signals.
Founder operational status artifacts remain repository-only until a server-side founder authorization boundary is established.
Volatile external reconciliation data in agent-system/state.json is a timestamped observation, never live authority; native systems must be reread before material work.
